name: haril-ts
description: File-lifecycle reconstruction for Windows, in Bun + TypeScript

scripts.build:js: bun build packages/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile dist/haril.js --target node --format esm --packages=external
scripts.build:native:linux: echo 'Native addon not built for Linux (capture not supported); analysis-only mode active'
scripts.build:native:macos: echo 'Native addon not built for macOS (capture not supported); analysis-only mode active'
scripts.build:package: bun run scripts/embed-native.ts && bun build packages/cli/src/cli.ts --outfile packages/cli/dist/cli.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:standalone: bun run embed:native && bun run build:exe-crossplatform
scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:native && bun run build:native:arm64 && bun run build:standalone
